plugins.name: Boxed Wine
plugins.description: A plugin that bundles a [Boxedwine](https://github.com/danoon2/Boxedwine) for running Windows applications (32-bit only). Experimental and not yet stable.

plugins.name: JS Paint
plugins.description: Recreation of Microsoft Paint for drawing and editing images. [jspaint](https://github.com/1j01/jspaint)

plugins.name: KeeNote
plugins.description: A secure, local-first note & password manager for the browser, built on [KeePass KDBX](https://keepass.info/help/kb/kdbx_4.html) files and [kdbxweb](https://github.com/keeweb/kdbxweb). Everything runs client-side — no server, no telemetry. Your `.kdbx` database never leaves your machine.

plugins.name: Markdown Viewer
plugins.description: A plugin for rendering and viewing Markdown documents, built on the [Marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) library.

plugins.name: Monaco Editor
plugins.description: A plugin that bundles the [Monaco](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor) code editor used in VS Code.

plugins.name: ONLYOFFICE
plugins.description: OnlyOffice Personal plugin for viewing and editing office documents. Source: [fernfei/OnlyofficePersonal](https://github.com/fernfei/OnlyofficePersonal)

plugins.name: Patchy
plugins.description: A fork of [Patchy](https://github.com/SethRobinson/Patchy) image editor. adapt to file-lite plugin

plugins.name: MediaDevices Player
plugins.description: Web application for playing system video/audio input devices

plugins.name: Webamp Player
plugins.description: Re-implementation of [Winamp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winamp) in HTML5 and JavaScript, featuring full skin support and playback capabilities.
